europe_now.title: Finnish President's Kremlin Call Sparks Nordic Rift
europe_now.summary: Finnish President Stubb conducted a 90-minute phone call with Vladimir Putin, seeking to influence Russian leadership. This diplomatic outreach has generated significant tension and division with Denmark.

sources.headline: Finnish president Stubb joins list of EU leaders seeking to tame Putin, in a 90-minute Kremlin phone call that caused a rift with Denmark

europe_now.title: US Selects Poland for Patriot Missile Facility
europe_now.summary: The United States has chosen Poland to host a new service and maintenance facility for Patriot missile systems. This development strengthens defense infrastructure on NATO's eastern flank.

sources.headline: US chooses Poland to host service facility for Patriot missiles

top_stories.title: EU Critical Minerals Strategy
top_stories.summary: The European Union is planning substantial financial investments in Australia's critical mineral sector. The initiative aims to reduce the bloc's heavy industrial reliance on China.

sources.headline: EU plans massive investment in Australia’s critical minerals to cut dependence on China

top_stories.title: French Legislative Debate on Rioter Liability
top_stories.summary: The French Senate is reviewing a controversial legislative measure requiring rioters to financially cover property damage caused during civil unrest. Civil rights organizations and various groups have criticized the proposed law as anti-democratic.

sources.headline: Rights groups say proposed French law to make rioters pay for damage is anti-democratic
